sources.name: NYC 311 Service Requests from 2020 to Present (2024 sample)
sources.license: NYC Open Data unrestricted use, subject to portal and provider terms
sources.sampling_method: First 1000 service requests in calendar 2024 ordered by created_date and unique_key; stable query, not representative of the whole year or India
limitations: No free-form complaint narrative in selected fields
US agencies cannot be treated as Indian department labels
Dates and agency values may change in the live source

sources.name: Nandi Grievance Synthetic (bounded multilingual research subset)
sources.license: Apache-2.0 stated in the Hugging Face dataset metadata
limitations: Generated text and labels are not human-reviewed ground truth
Generated urgency is not verified safety severity
No real-data accuracy claims may use this collection

sources.name: Enhanced Dataset of Citizen Centric Complaints and Grievances on Twitter
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 stated by repository; full-text rights and platform/privacy obligations unresolved
limitations: SQL archive includes tweet text with user, mention and coordinate tables; no verified text-only export
X platform-content redistribution and deletion/update obligations need a rights determination
Complaint/unknown annotation is not a civic category or department ground truth
Resolve platform-content terms and privacy treatment before acquisition

sources.name: Government of India: Grievance report (third-party Kaggle upload)
sources.license: Uploader-selected MIT in Kaggle metadata; underlying government rights unverified
limitations: Kaggle metadata reports a 1,064,105,293-byte archive but no exposed file schema or primary government provenance
Uploader-selected MIT does not establish original government or personal-data rights
No acquisition pending access and rights verification

sources.name: BBMP Sahaaya 2.0 citizen grievances, Vonter mirror
sources.license: Repository states ODbL 1.0, with some individual contents copyrighted by BBMP
limitations: Underlying BBMP reuse permission not independently established
Data dictionary has category, subcategory, status and staff remarks, not necessarily citizen complaint text
ODbL attribution and share-alike obligations apply to adapted databases

sources.name: CPGRAMS grievance details and movement APIs
sources.license: Restricted access; no public acquisition permission
limitations: Government guide explicitly marks complaint text and movement APIs restricted to registered hackathon users
No credentials or access workaround should be sought

sources.name: Janaagraha I Change My City complaint log 2019-2022
sources.license: CC BY-SA 2.0 stated by OpenCity resource metadata; publisher MD5 matched; attribution and share-alike apply
limitations: Normal publisher CSV was available from an already present browser download, but bounded field-selected API previously returned HTTP 403
Full source CSV included address/coordinates and was deleted after a minimized redacted extract was verified
All 1000 selected candidate narratives require human privacy and label review before use
CSV has no complaint ID column; IDs are export-checksum plus row-ordinal hashes
Bengaluru agency labels are not UP routing ground truth
